note: Posts the owner approves for the automatic launcher (scripts/launch.mjs): the X status ids of data/trending-cats.json posts that are not watch-list cats (a real pet, a name the rules guessed). An approved post still meets every other rule: not sensitive, not already in the sanctuary, at most 48 hours old, a picture, a clean name and X post, the caps. Add an id to approve it; remove it to take the approval back before it is prepared. A post that names no cat (a big account's cat post, listed under signals) launches when you name it: { "post": "<id or link>", "name": "<the cat's name>" }, with an optional "ticker" (else from the name), "kind" (real, cartoon or fiction; else real) and "lore" (one line about the cat; else the post's first sentence). Saving this file starts the launcher. The launcher only reads this file.

approve.name: Media Day Cat
approve.lore: A surprise kitten stole the show at a basketball media day
